title: Executive Assistant
description:
6 - 7 Month Contract

Our client searching for an Executive Assistant for our New York office. This organized multi-tasker will help support and manage the Development and Production offices – including the day-to-day management of two departments – with the purpose of meeting business initiatives, standards, for quality, value, and innovation for the network. The ideal candidate is extremely organized, with strong attention to detail, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:
• Provides key administrative and organizational support to two Senior Vice Presidents in the Production & Development Department.
• Work across internal departments and with key external industry stakeholders such as agents, writers, producers, talent, etc. to maintain smooth operations and accommodate priorities. This role will be the initial contact representing Turner.
• Deals with high level proprietary/confidential information.
• Maintains the flow of information between development, current programming, casting, and other departments within the division and the network as well as with the Entertainment community at large.
• Assist with the overall development and production processes throughout the entire creative and production cycles including but not limited to: generate, maintain and archive all project assets; compile, distribute, review, research and evaluate agendas, research projects, production company and project materials, etc.
• Create and implement procedures to better organize the department, track and maintain information, responsibilities and assignments, as well as strategize with teams on new and future opportunities.
• Manages and coordinates the scheduling of meetings, phone calls, travel, expense reports, and other administrative tasks.
• Maintain an organized office.

Required Qualifications and Experience:
• Prefer 2 years + of experience within the entertainment industry and 3+ years experience in an executive assistant role.
• Ideal candidate will be experienced in handling wide range of administrative and executive support related tasks. Be able to work independently with little or no supervision.
• Must be exceedingly well organized and flexible.
• Ability to interact with staff (at all levels) in a fast paced environment, remain flexible, proactive, resourceful and efficient, with a high level of professionalism and confidentiality is crucial.
• Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Proven ability to multi-task; must be able to constantly and consistently prioritize workload of executive and oneself simultaneously.
• Must be able to handle themselves professionally as they will have direct interaction with many other executives within the company as well as writers, producers, talent and other executives within the industry.
• The person in this position will also need to handle many sensitive documents and must be trusted with confidentiality.
• This individual must also have a solid understanding of the entertainment industry specifically as it relates to the creative side of the business.

title: Product Manager
description:
Long Term Contract
Hybrid

The main function of a product manager is to oversee the application of project management methodology during all phases of the product cycle, with responsibilities that include product design, scope management, cost control, quality and performance reporting.

Responsibilities:
• Develop, track and manage project budget, project plans, timelines and scope.
• Manage project resources including procuring project staff, developing, motivating, coaching and advising.
• Partner closely with other members of functional project teams to define business requirements.
• Lead teams of developers in the delivery of high-quality software solutions that meet business needs.
• Define test plans and ensure that products are defect free before User Acceptance Testing.
• Facilitate the User Acceptance Testing process, developing rollout plans and procedures.
• Prepare and present cost-benefit analyses.
• Ensure appropriate systems development and project management processes are being utilized.
• Make presentations to steering committees or project sponsors.

Required Qualifications: 
• Bachelor's degree in a technical field such as computer science, computer engineering or related field required. MBA or other related advanced degree preferred.
• PMP or PMI certification.
• Proven project management experience.
• People management and team building skills.
• Demonstrated ability to be flexible/ adaptable in exercising judgment in a changing environment and to manage competing priorities.
• Proven ability to learn business processes quickly and to work well with business partners at different levels within the organization.
• Strong ability to assess risk and apply management principles to technology applications/products and business functions.
• Experience delivering technology and business application solutions in a large-scale, multi-platform systems environment.
• 10+ years of experience

title: SAP Architect
description:
Long Term Project
USC or GC holders only

As an SAP Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing SAP solutions to meet business needs and align with architectural standards.
Designing and implementing SAP solutions, including SAP S/4HANA, to meet business requirements. Defining interaction requirements for components, subsystems, and interfaces within the SAP ecosystem. Providing strategic direction and guidance on SAP development and production fixes. Ensuring alignment of business and technology requirements with enterprise design. Collaborating with stakeholders to define vision, requirements, and ensure successful project delivery.

Required Skills:
1. 8+ years of hands-on SAP Project Systems (PS) experience, including design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
2. Analyze business requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and document functional specifications.
3. Excellent knowledge around key topics - Capital, Opex, External Projects, Resource Related Billing (RRB)
4. Integrate SAP PS with related modules (FI/CO, MM, SD,PM, HR) and external systems as needed.
5. Provide expert advice on best practices for project structure, cost planning, budgeting, scheduling, and reporting.
6. Support ongoing operations, troubleshoot issues, and resolve support tickets related to the SAP PS module.
7. Conduct workshops, training, and change management sessions for end-users and key stakeholders.
8. Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure solutions aligns with broader project and organizational objectives.
9. Maintain up-to-date documentation and ensure compliance with internal controls and audit requirements.
10. Drive continuous process improvement initiatives within the SAP project system landscape.

title: Cybersecurity Contractor
description:
Short Term Contract
Remote

Client is looking for a Cybersecurity Contractor, you will support the project team by ensuring the security and integrity of information systems and data. Conduct security assessments and vulnerability analyses to identify potential risks. Implement and maintain cybersecurity measures, including firewalls, encryption, and intrusion detection systems. Monitor and respond to security incidents and breaches, providing timely resolution. Develop and update security policies, procedures, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry standards. Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure cybersecurity best practices are integrated into all aspects of the project.

Domain Expertise
1. AWS Organizational Governance: Service Control Policies (SCP) design, multi-account patterns, delegated admin setups.
2. Logging & Audit Foundations: Org CloudTrail, AWS Config aggregator, S3 log archive hardening, GuardDuty, Security Hub.
3. CSPM / CNAPP Operations(Wiz.io): Onboarding accounts/resources, tuning posture policies, integrating with ticketing and log routing (e.g., Cribl/SIEM).
4. Infrastructure as Code: Terraform modules, reusable patterns, policy-as-code integration, CI scanning.
5. Vulnerability & Risk Prioritization: Combining CVSS, exploit context, asset criticality, and signal sources into severity logic.
6. Automation & Scripting: Python (boto3), AWS CLI, shell tooling for validation, evidence export, reporting.
7. Identity & Access: IAM least privilege, cross-account role assumptions, permission boundaries, automation roles.
8. Observability / Data Routing (Plus): Cribl / Firehose / Kinesis or equivalent pipeline familiarity.
9. Compliance Awareness: HIPAA safeguard themes (auditability, access control, data protection, etc).
10. Metrics & Reporting: Designing & extracting KPIs (coverage %, MTTR, SLA compliance, control efficacy).
